name: Thai Red Curry Shrimp with Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Mushroom & Rice (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
½ lb white mushrooms
¼ small pkg fresh basil
½ lime

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, place coconut milk, curry paste, sugar, and salt in a small saucepan. Whisk to combine, then bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until curry thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
1 ½ tbsp Thai curry paste, red
1 tsp brown sugar
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Cut lime into wedges.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide a ½-cup of rice, a ½-cup of shrimp, and 1 cup of veggies between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide red curry between bowls, then top with remaining rice, veggies, and shrimp. Sprinkle with basil, squeeze lime over top, and enjoy!
